finsights.brief: Management has been aggressively buying back shares
Holds more cash than debt on its balance sheet

summary: JD.com Q2 non-GAAP net income surged 21% to RMB 8.9B despite 2.9% revenue decline to RMB 346B, marking profitability inflection point.
JD Retail achieved record 4.6% operating margin during peak season; free cash flow jumped to RMB 31B from RMB 10B year-over-year.
Revenue weakness driven by electronics/appliances facing tough comparisons and pricing pressure; JD Logistics grew 24.3% offsetting retail decline.
Management forecasts Q3 retail revenue turning positive as comparison base eases; expects continued margin expansion and reduced new business losses.
Company returned $1B via buybacks in H1 2026, totaling $13B since 2023; maintains investments in AI, logistics automation, and European expansion.
